content_of_post_to_comment: Hey guys i am 28 and i have been smoking hash for 2 year every night after work i use to hit on bong and goes for phone watch videos reels and while time to sleep last bong to get sleep now i have been sober for 20 days everything was fine a week ago no cravings because i had panic attack last time i smoked that was the reason to quit and happy for that but these 4 nights i sleep for 8 hours but fragmented i sleep and i dream very vividly i remember every details and i wake up i dream atleast 4 dreams at night and i wake up in between those dreams that makes my sleep fragmented and i suffer tomorow at work i cannot focus i feel sleppy all the time i feel fatigued and anxious i only want to know for how many more days am i feeling this way i really want good long sleep and get rid off this feeling i want to live a normal life i am very happy quitting hash but these vivid dream is making me so bad tomorow at work i cannot explain the anxious feeling ass well
comment: The vivid dreams after quitting are actually something a lot of people report after stopping heavy cannabis use, especially when it was affecting your REM sleep for years. Your brain is basically adjusting back to its normal sleep pattern. The frustrating part is that the timing can feel random, but many people notice it gradually settles over the next few weeks. The fact that you connected the panic attack with quitting and have stayed sober for 20 days is a big shift. Are you noticing any improvement in daytime anxiety compared to the first week?
